summary:
Declaration audit of the q3a4 causal/noncausal reason fork: the essential-principles sense is represented by a primitive field, whereas the third sense is linked to Leibnizian explanation of the whole contingent series. Reject field wrappers, self-causation identification without a bridge, and defining explanatory adequacy by absence of efficient causes. No declarations, proof types, claims, or allowances changed. The existing conditional external-cause transcription and its omission controls are retained unchanged. Continuation: owner scope settled: retain the original entire contingent series, including infinite series; no individual replacement or avoidance sibling. Inventory reused PSRStrength.Arena (facts distinct from beings, explains an interpreted primitive), BCCFAt, CommonReason, Factive, Necessitating, ConjunctSound, Distribution and Coherent; ExplanatoryAdequacy.ReasonClosed, Founded, ContrastRelevant and UniformContrast; Modal.HistoryContrastive.SameHistory and Discriminates; JointGroups.Groups, Exercise.suffices, jointlySufficient, coherent and exercisedGroups; ConstitutiveNatureUniqueness.ConstitutiveContentComplete. These are available components, not faithful definitions of this sourced sense by name. Related series attempts history-contrastive-memberwise-omission.json and explanatory-regress-adequacy-311.json already reject necessity-only discrimination, local-to-total scope changes and adequacy by labels. No new source acquisition or historical interpretation is asserted.
Whole explanandum alternatives: (A) a fact aggregating every actual contingent fact, with BCCFAt supplying coverage only; it does not supply exact membership, converse conjunction truth or an aggregate's existence. If intended as the full actual order rather than a superset, add explicit exact membership and truth conditions, not hidden extensionality. This includes contingent laws/arrangements, not merely individual existence. (B) the entire contingent-substance series represented by a set of beings and its complete existence history; SameHistory gives pointwise presence comparison without reifying a substance called the universe. This omits qualitative/law differences unless the history is explicitly enlarged. An existence-only history therefore cannot be advertised as the full original order. Recommendation: preserve all relevant contingent-order content with explicitly stated coverage; do not choose an existence-only reduction. Owner question: does the series include contingent laws/relations as explananda, or substances together with all their states? These require different aggregate membership maps; neither authorizes dropping order content.
Externality alternatives: (A) reason fact not a conjunct/member of the contingent aggregate; (B) reason borne by an existing substance not among the contingent substances. A necessary law-fact can satisfy A with no necessary bearer; B requires a fact-to-bearer realization bridge and an actual necessary substance. Arena.exist plus Coherent can express existence-fact realization, but identifying every explanatory reason with exist b would exclude nature/action facts without justification. Keep the original necessary-substance clause explicit, with a separate bearer/content map if reasons are its nature or action. Membership externality does not entail absence of causal action, temporal priority, spatial exteriority or explanatory independence. A reason outside the member list could still depend on the series: forbid that only with an explicit dependency/closure condition, not a naming convention.
Adequacy alternatives with exact impact: (A) truth-entailing contrast: an obtaining reason excludes every accessible order differing in the explanandum. Reuse Discriminates only after complete-order representation is fixed. Necessary reason truth then forbids accessible differing order by necessary_discriminating_excludes_rival; for a contingent aggregate, PSRStrength.necessitating_reason_contingent shows every true necessitating reason is contingent. Thus this reading conflicts with a necessary reason and genuine contingency; it does not prove a necessary substance cannot act contingently. (B) nonnecessitating full determination/ground: a substance may exist necessarily while its reason-content or exercise selects the actual contingent order. Arena separates existence from facts and ExplanatoryAdequacy.TwoWay admits a shared reason at opposite outcomes, but neither defines what makes the selection explanatory. It needs a specified nature/action/selection rule rather than a free explains flag. Impact: retains contingent effects and necessary bearer, adds no modal collapse, but explanatory adequacy remains unresolved until that rule is given. ReasonClosed/Founded are optional structural demands, not the missing rule: tokenExpand admits an irrelevant necessary token; BeingStop builds a necessary bearer into the criterion and cannot derive it independently. Recommendation: do not adopt necessitation or BeingStop as a silent definition of sufficient reason. Ask owner whether sufficiency means truth-entailing discrimination or a nonnecessitating reason through contingent exercise; if the latter, what positive selection account is intended (nature-fixed outcome, reason-guided choice, or structural global determination)? Nature-fixed necessary content entails collapse under the first standard; reason-guided choice requires action/alternative/reason structure; global determination still owes direction and actual realization and does not supply a substance by itself.
Essential-principles alternatives: use a separate Principle carrier (existing Article4.Profile already has one), an essential-of relation, and a set of these principles; do not replace the set by the being acting as its own agent. (A) intrinsic productive powers: events exercising those principles have bearer x, target x's esse, with an exercised admitted joint record whose members are all intrinsic exercises and whose complete contributor/enabler set suffices. JointGroups supplies record, exercise, bearers and scenario tests; no theorem identifies these events with principles, and their efficient productivity must be independently interpreted. Sufficiency is relative to the full allowed background, so a suppressed external enabler would invalidate alone. This reading adds exercise/realization and scenario-domain obligations and must not imply temporal self-creation. (B) constitutive essence facts necessitate the esse fact without productive exercise. ConstitutiveContentComplete concerns identity of nature values only and gives no existence; turning it into efficient cause would change the original sense to noncausal entailment. Reject B as completion of sense1. Within A the remaining concrete question is whether alone means a complete intrinsic sufficient route (another redundant external route may coexist), or no external actual contribution whatsoever. The latter is stronger: an overdetermined subject satisfies the former and fails the latter. The existing definition says sufficient alone, not absence of all contribution; favor the complete intrinsic route reading, without requiring indispensable contributions, and retain the no-self-cause exclusion as an open premise. No existing proof or Profile field is replaced, no allowances removed, no new adequacy or completion claim made.
Owner answers 2026-11-09 incorporated: ALL contingent facts including laws/relations; necessary substance bearer; retain entailing and nonnecessitating siblings. Added WholeSeriesReason.SameOrder, CarriedReason, EntailingWholeReason and ReasonGuidedWholeExercise. No original declaration or allowance is cleared. The latter is an explicitly analyst optimal-choice interpretation, not certified adequacy: complete valuation, feasibility, actual choice, no better feasible option, and an accessible omission of the same exercise. This avoids bare sufficient flags but does not settle whether ties are adequately explained by volition or need additional reason-guided selection. Existing Clarke volitional sufficient-reason definition supplies a relevant rival, not an identity or historical attribution. Entailing contradiction is already supported by existing PSRStrength necessitating_reason_contingent and HistoryContrastive necessary discrimination results; no new certified consequence is registered. No claim of model nonvacuity or theorem verification is made for the new sibling types. Scope/root connection remains the original series statement 702e4171-b48d-5c5e-a016-6bfd5cc67225; missing bridge is explanatory adequacy, not aggregate membership. Essential sufficiency remains untouched: complete intrinsic productive route with possible redundant external route; no identification with agent self-causation.
Continuation after owner answer, 2026-11-09: BOTH analyst adequacy policies retained. Weak accepts original optimal choice, even with ties; stronger additionally requires a positive selector of this particular optimum. Added first-feasible-optimum agenda execution, supplied before and independently of actual choice, not an outcome-coded preference. Scanner uniqueness, decidable existence exactly when an eligible agenda member exists, eligibility transport and uniform stronger-to-weaker scope proved by list induction. Local stronger-to-original weakening retains identical exercise data. Full extensional Bool-world proposition domain witnesses an original nonvacuous exercise with actual necessary bearer, obtaining necessary content and contingent option; both options optimal. Fixed agenda [false,true] permits the actual false exercise, but uniform selection fails at true despite uniform optimality. Reverse [true,false] and empty agendas do not select the SAME actual option. These exact omissions do not claim global absence of every possible adequate account. Uniform policies range over every world/bearer/content/recorded choice and alone have no existence import; stability needs two positive selections and extensionally equal eligibility, while constructive existence requires DecidablePred and a witnessed eligible agenda member. Unbounded or empty option spaces do not silently get an optimum. Coverage of all adequate analyst interpretations and exclusive intended reading remain open, not inferred from a two-policy comparison. New batch specs/whole-series-choice-policies.toml and exploration map record root connection as OPEN; prior entailing sibling unchanged. No original completion or allowance removal. A second positive full-fact control chooses at the actual world and abstains at the accessible rival, satisfying the UNIFORM stronger policy nonvacuously while retaining contingent exercise. Thus fixed uniform selection alone does not entail exercise necessity; nonempty actual selection is explicit and worldwise total choice is not assumed.
blocker: Owner adequacy-choice question is resolved by retaining both policies; no further owner choice is required for these conditional results. Remaining OPEN obligations: independently meaningful agenda authority and calibration, content relevance and explanatory direction (not an order chosen merely to fit observed output), correspondence to real full contingent facts and substances, applicability/actuality and source correspondence. Original sourced sense3 is not completed by these analyst siblings. Sense1 still requires complete intrinsic productive principle/exercise realization without forbidding redundant external contributions. Next bounded slice: compare independently specified positive selectors or encode a faithful source-to-policy bridge only if that correspondence is explicitly selected; neither a bare adequate flag nor agenda registration supplies it.
label: Q3a4 essential efficient sufficiency and whole-series reason declaration blockers
